meta.title: Rumo Beach Baleal | Surf School, Coaching and Rentals
meta.description: Surf school in Baleal for all levels and ages: lessons, coaching, academy, programmes for children and teens, and equipment rental.

hero.title: Surf for everyone.
hero.body: Our instructors guide every session with patience, experience and a deep knowledge of the sea here in Baleal.

offerings.title: Surf Lessons
offerings.body: For all levels. Every lesson is tailored to the individual and the conditions of the day.

offerings.title: Surf Coaching
offerings.body: Focused on developing movement and technique. From high performance to longboard, twin fin and alternative styles.

offerings.title: Family Experience
offerings.body: Time shared in and out of the water, for the whole family.

offerings.title: Programmes for Children and Teens
offerings.body: Surf lessons, beach activities and holiday camps for children and teens. Get in touch to find out the start dates!

offerings.title: Equipment Rental
offerings.body: Premium surf equipment, ready to hit the water.
